title: K-Tech Build: Matthew 7:24 on the fish, 4 verses, all caps (QR direct)
notes: K-Tech card (Ken, 19 Nov): the fish carries Matthew 7:24 (KJV), the wise man who built his house upon a rock, drawn by the same code as the website's builder, Build word 700. Matthew 7:24 is not repeated on the back (Nehemiah 2:18 takes its place). QR codes go straight to their addresses.
